method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 2,682 postings; 1,745 were older than 7 days, 84 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 265 were senior or excluded titles, 258 were not target roles, 156 failed Kenya eligibility, 27 were already applied to and 42 were duplicates. ReliefWeb failed in the automated search (parse error) and the automated Wellfound fetch is disabled by design. Jobgether returned 501 roles and 203 fresh; 31 passed the filters but every shortlisted one lists Europe, the EU or North America without naming Kenya, so none were kept. micro1 returned 68 roles and 7 fresh; the only new one is a Europe-only agent tester, so there is nothing new for Ben there. Browser passes (signed in, 25 Nov): Wellfound (about 50 listings seen, 5 opened, 3 shortlisted), Fuzu (about 50 seen, 1 kept) and the MyJobMag personalised feed (about 25 on the first page, 1 kept). Of the live-search shortlist, the GitLab roles are locked to Canada, the US, the UK or Poland. EdgeQ's Full Stack (AI), ETL Developer and QA Engineer listings are tagged Worldwide on Himalayas, but the listing text restricts each one to the United States, so they are dropped. Four roles that passed the filters and are new today were not opened on the employer page, so they are shortlisted as unchecked: Stripe Backend Engineer, Ritual Software Engineer Intern, Twilio DevOps Engineer (Observability), and Cegeka Data Engineer MS Fabric. We Work Remotely's Anywhere in the World label is often wrong. Canonical's Observability role, plus the three Wellfound roles, were re-checked by hand.

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo, an open-source runtime that shields running Linux systems
stories.summary: In a controlled test, a Codex-generated shield blocked a Java4Shell exploit attempt against a running Elasticsearch service without a restart; Shirudo uses eBPF, and operators approve a shield before it is deployed.
stories.why: Shows Codex-generated, human-approved fixes being applied to live systems, a pattern he can reuse in agent workflows with an approval step.

stories.title: Google DeepMind launches Humanity's First Exam to test how reliably LLMs answer everyday questions
stories.summary: The benchmark has 544 elementary text and image prompts across 20 foundational capabilities, measures whether models answer correctly every time rather than once, and comes with a Kaggle competition running through December 15.
stories.why: Reliability across repeated runs is what matters when he puts an LLM inside a product, and this gives a public way to measure it.

stories.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 models can design proteins using only reasoning and code
stories.summary: In lab tests with Onava, proteins based on GPT-6.2's designs showed evidence of binding across five targets, and redesigned antibodies retained binding; an internal research model matched or outperformed specialized models on many design tasks.
stories.why: A signal that general-purpose models using code as a tool are replacing specialist models in new fields, which is how agent tooling is heading.

stories.title: South African founder's Lupa Robotics raises $1.67 million seed to teach robots human dexterity
stories.summary: Long Journey Ventures led the round; the company will use the money to hire engineers, develop tactile sensing and data-collection systems, and build human-manipulation datasets.
stories.why: An African-founded AI company that is hiring engineers, and a sign investors are funding applied AI beyond chatbots.

stories.title: AidenAI raises $32 million Series A to build and deploy enterprise AI agents
stories.summary: A91 Partners led the round; the company says it plans a team of more than 1,000 frontier AI engineers through its AidenAI Builder Academy in Princeton and Hyderabad, and serves over 30 enterprise clients.
stories.why: An agent-building company planning to hire AI engineers in large numbers, in the area where he has built pipelines.

stories.title: Ajira AI brings job matching, CV tailoring and application autofill into one platform
stories.summary: Founded by Gideon Kiratu, a former Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft, the platform combines job discovery, CV tailoring, cover letter generation, skills matching and help filling recruitment forms.
stories.why: A Kenyan product built around the exact job-search workflow he is going through, and an example of a local AI startup.

stories.title: Japan survey: 19.6% of firms recruiting graduates for clerical jobs plan to hire fewer as AI spreads
stories.summary: Mynavi surveyed 1,667 companies; 10.3% of those hiring graduates for IT jobs are considering hiring more, with demand strongest among manufacturers adopting AI.
stories.why: AI is cutting routine entry-level roles while IT hiring holds up, which favours graduates who can show technical work.

stories.title: Microsoft expands early-career programs while offering buyouts to about 60,000 employees
stories.summary: The Wire cites Revelio Labs data that entry-level postings fell 35% between 2023 and 2026, and says Microsoft's Aspire program had 2,100 global participants this year.
stories.why: Even as entry-level postings shrink, big employers are still investing in AI-fluent early-career talent.

stories.title: Nigeria's data regulator targets a 500,000-job data protection pipeline
stories.summary: The NDPC says the ecosystem has created more than 27,000 jobs in under three years and that Nigeria has over 10,000 certified data protection officers, and it wants to export compliance talent.
stories.why: Privacy and compliance skills are in demand across African fintech, and data protection work is a possible remote-friendly niche.

stories.title: Safaricom says 3.7 million customers have opted into M-PESA Shiriki Pay
stories.summary: Shiriki Pay lets a sponsor give up to five beneficiaries access to their M-PESA wallet, each with a monthly limit of up to KES 20,000; beneficiaries cannot withdraw cash or see the balance or history.
stories.why: A concrete delegated-spending feature on M-PESA, relevant to wallet permission and limit design.

stories.title: Safaricom says AI helps prevent 94% of fraud attempts before they occur
stories.summary: The company uses AI for fraud detection, credit scoring and network planning; its annual report says Fintech 2.0 raised M-PESA capacity from about 4,500 to 6,000 transactions per second, scalable to 10,000.
stories.why: Shows how fraud detection and lending models sit inside Kenya's biggest payments platform, close to the work he has done on loan pipelines.

stories.title: Kenya's eCitizen platform named in an unverified data breach allegation
stories.summary: VECERT claimed on X that about 740 GB was taken, including roughly 600 GB of KYC documents and 40 GB of source code; Techweez says no public confirmation of the breach was found.
stories.why: A reminder of why file-upload validation and secure authentication matter in government and fintech systems.
